scenario_translation: 我的主管总是表现得比别人优越，这让团队很不舒服。

scenario_translation: 我那位来自英格兰的朋友说，那里的人总是在谈论天气。

scenario_translation: 和触摸屏相比，我旧手机上的旋转拨号盘用起来非常慢。

chinese_meanings: vt. 使困惑， 把…弄糊涂； 混淆， 把…混同； 混乱， 搞乱
scenario_example: The instructions on this medicine bottle confuse me because they are not clear.
scenario_translation: 这个药瓶上的说明把我搞糊涂了，因为写得不清楚。

scenario_example: The dark alley behind my house looks scary at night, so I never walk there alone.
scenario_translation: 我家后面的那条黑巷子晚上看起来很吓人，所以我从不一个人走那里。

scenario_example: The population of my small town has grown a lot because many people moved here from big cities.
scenario_translation: 我所在的小镇人口增长了很多，因为很多人从大城市搬了过来。

chinese_meanings: adj. 苦干的，不辞辛劳的
scenario_example: My father is a hardworking man; he gets up at 5 AM every day to go to work.
scenario_translation: 我父亲是个勤劳的人，他每天早上5点起床去上班。

scenario_example: I need to buy an air conditioning unit for my living room before summer starts.
scenario_translation: 在夏天到来之前，我需要给客厅买一个空调室内机。

chinese_meanings: n. 授予物；补助金；vt. 授予， 给予； 同意
scenario_example: The government granted me a student loan to help pay for my university tuition.
scenario_translation: 政府批准了我的学生贷款，帮我支付大学学费。

chinese_meanings: n. 托儿所， 保育室； 苗圃
scenario_example: We sent our son to a nursery near our home so he could play with other children.
scenario_translation: 我们把儿子送到了家附近的一所幼儿园，让他能和别的小朋友一起玩。

chinese_meanings: v. 冷凝， 凝结； 浓缩， 压缩， 简缩
scenario_example: The cold glass of water condensed water droplets on the outside, wetting the table.
scenario_translation: 那杯冰水在外壁凝结了水珠，把桌子弄湿了。

chinese_meanings: adj. 意大利的n意大利人
scenario_example: I learned to cook Italian food from my neighbor, who was born in Rome.
scenario_translation: 我跟我的邻居学了做意大利菜，他是在罗马出生的。

scenario_example: My boss gave me some constructive criticism on my report, which helped me improve it.
scenario_translation: 老板对我的报告提出了一些建设性的批评，帮助我改进了它。

chinese_meanings: v. 伸展，延续；伸长，拉长；倾注全力；紧张；n. 一段时间， 一段路程， 连绵的一片； 伸展， 延伸
scenario_example: I need to stretch my legs after sitting in front of the computer for three hours.
scenario_translation: 在电脑前坐了三个小时后，我需要伸伸腿。

scenario_example: You can either pay by cash or by credit card, whichever is easier for you.
scenario_translation: 你可以用现金或信用卡支付，哪种对你更方便就用哪种。

chinese_meanings: adj. 种族的， 人种的
scenario_example: My company has a strict policy against any form of racial discrimination in the workplace.
scenario_translation: 我公司有严格的政策，禁止工作场所任何形式的种族歧视。

scenario_example: My mother gave me a very practical gift: a set of cooking pots that I use every day.
scenario_translation: 我妈妈给了我一件非常实用的礼物：一套我每天都会用的煮锅。

scenario_example: The charger for my laptop says it outputs 3 amperes of current, which is quite high.
scenario_translation: 我笔记本电脑的充电器上写着输出电流为3安培，算是相当高了。

chinese_meanings: n. 织物， 纺织品； 结构
scenario_example: I chose a soft cotton fabric for my new bedsheet because it feels nice against the skin.
scenario_translation: 我为新床单选了柔软的棉质面料，因为摸起来很舒服。

scenario_example: I carried a tray full of coffee cups to my colleagues, carefully trying not to spill any.
scenario_translation: 我端着一整托盘咖啡杯走向同事，小心翼翼地不想洒出来。

scenario_example: A fly kept buzzing around my head while I was trying to eat my lunch.
scenario_translation: 我正吃午饭的时候，一只苍蝇一直在我脑袋边嗡嗡叫。

scenario_example: I live near a supermarket, so it only takes me two minutes to buy groceries.
scenario_translation: 我住在一家超市附近，所以买日用品只需要走两分钟。

scenario_example: After being sick for a week, I still felt too feeble to go back to work.
scenario_translation: 病了一周后，我仍然觉得太虚弱，无法回去工作。

scenario_example: The strange noise coming from my car engine is very puzzling; I have no idea what's wrong.
scenario_translation: 我汽车引擎发出的奇怪声音很令人困惑，我完全不知道哪里出了问题。

chinese_meanings: n. 基础， 根据； 原则
scenario_example: I meet with my team on a daily basis to quickly discuss what we need to do.
scenario_translation: 我每天都和我的团队碰面，快速讨论一下我们需要做什么。

chinese_meanings: adj. 复杂的； 精心制作的；v. 详述， 详细制订
scenario_example: My friend gave me an elaborate explanation of how to fix the printer, but I still didn't understand.
scenario_translation: 我的朋友详细地给我解释了怎么修打印机，但我还是没懂。

chinese_meanings: n. 光荣， 荣誉的事； 美丽
scenario_example: The athlete finally achieved glory by winning a gold medal after years of hard training.
scenario_translation: 经过多年的艰苦训练，这位运动员终于赢得了金牌，获得了荣誉。

scenario_example: I need to feed my cat before I go to work, or she will meow all day.
scenario_translation: 我上班前得喂猫，不然它会叫一整天。

scenario_example: I wanted to buy the blue jacket, but it was too expensive, so I got the black one instead.
scenario_translation: 我想买那件蓝色夹克，但是太贵了，所以我买了黑色的。

chinese_meanings: n. 实习生身份； 实习医师期
scenario_example: I did an internship at a law firm last summer, and I learned a lot about real cases.
scenario_translation: 去年夏天我在一家律师事务所实习，学到了很多关于真实案例的知识。

scenario_example: There is a little coffee shop around the corner where they make excellent cappuccino.
scenario_translation: 街角有一家小小的咖啡店，他们做的卡布奇诺非常棒。

scenario_example: My brother built a detailed model of a ship, and he painted it carefully.
scenario_translation: 我弟弟做了一个精细的船模，还仔细地给它上了色。

scenario_example: The movie was so lengthy that I fell asleep twice before it ended.
scenario_translation: 那部电影太长了，在结束前我睡着了两次。

scenario_example: I value my privacy, so I never share my room with anyone when I travel.
scenario_translation: 我重视个人隐私，所以旅行时从不和别人合住一个房间。

scenario_example: My cousin is an engineer who designs bridges, and he often travels to construction sites.
scenario_translation: 我表哥是位桥梁工程师，他经常要去建筑工地。

scenario_example: Perhaps we can go to the beach this weekend if the weather is nice.
scenario_translation: 如果天气好的话，也许我们这个周末可以去海滩。

scenario_example: It is the responsibility of parents and teachers to educate children about right and wrong.
scenario_translation: 教育孩子明辨是非是家长和老师的责任。

chinese_meanings: n. 中风；一举，一次努力；划桨，划水；击，敲；报时的钟声；笔画，一笔；抚摸；vt. 抚摸
scenario_example: I learned to do the front crawl stroke in swimming class, but I am still not fast.
scenario_translation: 我在游泳课上学会了爬泳（自由泳），但还是游不快。

scenario_example: There was a power cut last night, so we had to use candles to see.
scenario_translation: 昨晚停电了，所以我们只好点着蜡烛照明。

scenario_example: I spilled red wine on my light-colored carpet, and now there is a big stain.
scenario_translation: 我把红酒洒在了浅色的地毯上，现在有一大块污渍。

scenario_example: The little black box on my phone charger is a transformer that changes the voltage.
scenario_translation: 我手机充电器上的那个小黑盒子就是一个改变电压的变压器。

chinese_meanings: n. 资金，基金；存款；vt. 为…提供资金
scenario_example: I am saving money in a fund for my daughter's future university education.
scenario_translation: 我在一个基金里存钱，用于女儿将来的大学教育。

scenario_example: My grandmother taught me how to sew a button back onto my shirt when it falls off.
scenario_translation: 我祖母教我在衬衫扣子掉了之后怎么把它缝回去。

chinese_meanings: vt. 征服， 战胜； 破除， 克服
scenario_example: It took me months to conquer my fear of speaking in public, but I finally did it.
scenario_translation: 我花了好几个月才克服对公开演讲的恐惧，但最终我做到了。

scenario_example: I read an interesting article online about how sleep affects our memory.
scenario_translation: 我在网上读了一篇有趣的文章，讲的是睡眠如何影响我们的记忆力。

chinese_meanings: vi. 给人印象，引人注目；vt. 给…深刻印象；印，压印；n. 印记； 特征
scenario_example: I tried to impress my boss by finishing the project early, but he didn't even notice.
scenario_translation: 我试图通过提前完成项目来给老板留下好印象，但他根本没注意到。

scenario_example: A little boy on the street asked me for directions to the nearest library.
scenario_translation: 街上一个小男孩问我附近最近的图书馆怎么走。

scenario_example: Calling him a coward is unfair; he was just scared like everyone else would be.
scenario_translation: 说他是懦夫不公平，他只是像其他任何人一样感到了害怕。

scenario_example: I will drive you to the station, because it's raining heavily outside.
scenario_translation: 我会开车送你去车站，因为外面正下着大雨。

scenario_example: My dream of owning a real sports car came true after I saved money for five years.
scenario_translation: 在我存了五年钱之后，拥有一辆真正的跑车的梦想成真了。

scenario_example: My main goal this year is to learn to play the guitar well enough to play a song.
scenario_translation: 我今年的主要目标是学好吉他，能弹出一首歌来。

scenario_example: The spy wore a dark cloak so that no one would recognize him in the night.
scenario_translation: 间谍穿了一件深色斗篷，这样在夜里就没人能认出他了。

scenario_example: I saw a line of ants carrying crumbs across my kitchen floor this morning.
scenario_translation: 今天早上我看见一排蚂蚁搬运着面包屑穿过我厨房的地板。

scenario_example: The worm I found in the garden was about five centimetres long and very thin.
scenario_translation: 我在花园里发现的那条虫子大约有五厘米长，非常细。

scenario_example: After a long day of work, a hot bath is the best way for me to relax.
scenario_translation: 漫长的一天工作之后，洗个热水澡对我来说是最好的放松方式。

scenario_example: The ball left the bat with such high velocity that I couldn't even see it.
scenario_translation: 球以极高的速度离开球棒，我甚至都没看清。

scenario_example: I broke a glass while washing dishes, so I had to be careful cleaning up the pieces.
scenario_translation: 我洗碗时打碎了一个玻璃杯，所以清理碎片时得非常小心。

scenario_example: I would rather stay at home and read a book than go to a crowded party.
scenario_translation: 我宁愿待在家里看书，也不愿意去一个拥挤的派对。

scenario_example: My desk is in complete disorder with papers and pens everywhere, but I know where everything is.
scenario_translation: 我的书桌一片混乱，到处是文件和笔，但我知道每样东西在哪。

scenario_example: I don't believe in fate; I think we make our own choices and decide our future.
scenario_translation: 我不相信命运，我认为我们自己做选择，决定我们的未来。

chinese_meanings: adj. 更少的；adv. 更少地
scenario_example: If you want to lose weight, you should eat less sugar and exercise more.
scenario_translation: 如果你想减肥，你应该少吃糖，多运动。

chinese_meanings: vi. 聚集， 结成一伙；n. 一帮，一伙

scenario_translation: 昨晚深夜，一群青少年在我窗外吵闹。

scenario_example: The airline treats its first-class passengers preferentially, giving them faster check-in.
scenario_translation: 这家航空公司优先对待头等舱乘客，让他们更快办理登机手续。

chinese_meanings: adj. 沉思的； 体贴的
scenario_example: It was very thoughtful of you to bring me a cup of tea when I was working late.
scenario_translation: 我加班到很晚的时候你给我端来一杯茶，你真是太体贴了。

chinese_meanings: vi. 发生冲突；不协调；砰地相撞，发出刺耳的撞击声；n. 冲突； 不协调； 刺耳的撞击声
scenario_example: My brother's loud music clashed with my need to study for an exam, so we had an argument.
scenario_translation: 我弟弟吵闹的音乐和我复习备考的需求冲突了，所以我们吵了一架。

scenario_example: The loud noise of a car backfiring triggered my dog's fear, and he ran under the bed.
scenario_translation: 汽车回火的巨大响声触发了我的狗的恐惧，它跑到了床底下。

scenario_example: I find astrophysics fascinating, but it is too difficult for me to understand completely.
scenario_translation: 我觉得天体物理学很迷人，但对我来说太难完全理解了。

scenario_example: It took a lot of effort to clean the whole house, but I felt satisfied afterward.
scenario_translation: 打扫整个房子费了很大力气，但之后我感到很满足。

chinese_meanings: adj. 否定的，消极的；负的；阴性的；n. 负片， 底片； 负数
scenario_example: Don't be so negative about the test result; you might have done better than you think.
scenario_translation: 别对考试结果这么悲观，你可能考得比你想的要好。

chinese_meanings: n. 州长； 主管人员； 理事， 董事
scenario_example: The governor of our state visited our town and spoke at the local high school.
scenario_translation: 我们州的州长到访了我们小镇，并在当地高中发表了讲话。

scenario_example: I have a strange feeling that I forgot to lock the front door this morning.
scenario_translation: 我有一种奇怪的感觉，好像今天早上忘了锁前门。

scenario_example: I spread some butter on my toast, but it was too hard to spread evenly.
scenario_translation: 我往吐司上抹了些黄油，但是黄油太硬了，抹不均匀。

chinese_meanings: adj. 复合的，多重的，多样的；n. 倍数
scenario_example: I have multiple alarms set on my phone to make sure I wake up on time.
scenario_translation: 我在手机上设了好几个闹钟，确保我能按时起床。

chinese_meanings: vt. 缚， 系， 贴； 附加； 使依恋， 使喜爱； 使附属； 认为有
scenario_example: Please attach a photo to your application form, otherwise it will not be accepted.
scenario_translation: 请在你的申请表上附上一张照片，否则不会被接受。

scenario_example: I always feel nervous before giving a presentation, even if I have prepared well.
scenario_translation: 在做演示之前我总是很紧张，即使我已经准备得很充分了。

scenario_example: The local radio station will broadcast the football game live tonight.
scenario_translation: 本地广播电台今晚将现场直播这场足球赛。

chinese_meanings: adj. 丰富的， 充足的； 大量的
scenario_example: During summer, fresh vegetables are plentiful at the farmers' market near my home.
scenario_translation: 夏天的时候，我家附近的农贸市场里新鲜蔬菜非常充足。

scenario_example: My grandparents' house was built more than a century ago, but it is still strong.
scenario_translation: 我曾祖父母的房子建在一个多世纪以前，但现在仍然很坚固。

scenario_example: We had a long debate at dinner about whether a hot dog is a sandwich or not.
scenario_translation: 我们晚饭时进行了一场漫长的辩论，讨论热狗算不算三明治。

scenario_example: I put a groundsheet under my tent to keep the floor dry from the wet grass.
scenario_translation: 我在帐篷下面铺了一块防潮布，防止湿草地弄湿帐底。

chinese_meanings: vt. 围， 围绕； 圈住
scenario_example: The tall trees surround my house, providing shade and privacy.
scenario_translation: 高高的树木环绕着我的房子，提供了阴凉和隐私。

scenario_example: I pay for health insurance every month so that medical bills won't ruin me financially.
scenario_translation: 我每月支付健康保险，这样医疗账单就不会让我破产。

scenario_example: I believe my friend when he says he will help me move this weekend.
scenario_translation: 我相信我的朋友说这个周末会帮我搬家。

chinese_meanings: vt. 批准，认可；n. 批准， 认可； 约束因素， 约束力；  国际制裁
scenario_example: The government placed sanctions on certain imports, making them more expensive.
scenario_translation: 政府对一些进口商品实施了制裁，使它们更贵了。

chinese_meanings: n. 沟， 沟渠， 渠道
scenario_example: We had to ditch our plan to go camping because the weather forecast was terrible.
scenario_translation: 因为天气预报太糟糕了，我们不得不放弃去露营的计划。

chinese_meanings: n. 业余爱好， 癖好
scenario_example: My main hobby is collecting old coins, which I find very relaxing.
scenario_translation: 我的主要爱好是收集旧硬币，我觉得这很让人放松。

scenario_example: France is a republic, which means its head of state is a president, not a king or queen.
scenario_translation: 法国是一个共和国，这意味着它的国家元首是总统，而不是国王或女王。

scenario_example: The toilet in the public restroom was clogged, so I had to use another one.
scenario_translation: 公厕里的马桶堵了，所以我只好用另一个。

scenario_example: I have over a hundred unread emails in my inbox that I need to sort through.
scenario_translation: 我的收件箱里有超过一百封未读邮件需要处理。

scenario_example: My mother was a housewife for many years, taking care of us and the home.
scenario_translation: 我母亲很多年都是家庭主妇，照顾我们和孩子。

scenario_example: I nearly missed my train this morning because I hit every red light on the way.
scenario_translation: 今天早上我差点错过火车，因为路上每个红灯都碰上了。

chinese_meanings: n. 羊毛； 毛线， 绒线
scenario_example: My sweater is made of wool, so it is very warm but also a bit itchy.
scenario_translation: 我的毛衣是羊毛的，所以很暖和，但也有点扎人。

scenario_example: The service at the restaurant dissatisfied me because the waiter forgot our order.
scenario_translation: 那家餐厅的服务让我不满意，因为服务员忘了我们的点单。

scenario_example: When I lie on the beach and listen to the waves, I feel like I am in heaven.
scenario_translation: 当我躺在沙滩上听海浪声时，感觉就像在天堂一样。

chinese_meanings: v. 暗示， 示意；n. 暗示，示意；细微的迹象；建议
scenario_example: My mom gave me a hint about my birthday gift by saying it was something I could wear.
scenario_translation: 我妈妈给了我一个关于生日礼物的提示，说那是我可以穿的东西。

scenario_example: My father often calls his old army friends "comrade" when he talks about them.
scenario_translation: 我父亲在谈论他过去的战友时，常常称他们为"同志"。

scenario_example: His lack of punctuality was his downfall, and he eventually lost his job.
scenario_translation: 他缺乏时间观念是他的弱点，最终导致他丢了工作。

scenario_example: The light is hanging above the table, but it doesn't shine bright enough.
scenario_translation: 灯就挂在桌子上方，但不够亮。

scenario_example: I installed new software on my computer to edit my vacation photos.
scenario_translation: 我在电脑上安装了新软件，用来编辑我的度假照片。

scenario_example: I had a small quarrel with my neighbor about his tree branches hanging over my fence.
scenario_translation: 我和邻居因为他的树枝伸到了我的篱笆上面而发生了一点小口角。

scenario_example: You must wear a helmet when riding a bike; it can save your life in an accident.
scenario_translation: 骑自行车时必须戴头盔，在发生事故时可以救你的命。

scenario_example: It took many years to civilize the wild land, building schools and roads.
scenario_translation: 用了很多年时间来开化这片荒野之地，建设学校和道路。

scenario_example: I was in the midst of cooking dinner when the phone rang.
scenario_translation: 我正忙着做晚饭的时候，电话响了。

scenario_example: I can't open the lid of this jar; it's stuck too tightly.
scenario_translation: 我打不开这个罐子的盖子，拧得太紧了。

scenario_example: I need to go to the grocery store to buy milk, eggs, and bread for breakfast.
scenario_translation: 我得去杂货店买早餐用的牛奶、鸡蛋和面包。

scenario_example: I made this cup of coffee myself, so I hope it tastes okay.
scenario_translation: 这杯咖啡是我自己做的，所以我希望味道还行。

scenario_example: A mouse ran across my kitchen floor last night, and I set a trap to catch it.
scenario_translation: 昨晚一只老鼠跑过我的厨房地板，我设了个捕鼠器抓它。

scenario_example: This area of the city is very quiet, so I like to go for a walk here in the evening.

chinese_meanings: n. 香烟， 纸烟， 卷烟

scenario_translation: 吸烟对你的肺和周围的人都有害。

chinese_meanings: n. 半，一半；adj. 一半的

scenario_translation: 我吃了一半的披萨，把剩下的留到明天。

scenario_example: This book is mine, and that one is hers.
scenario_translation: 这本书是我的，那本是她的。

scenario_example: The next bus to the city center arrives in five minutes.
scenario_translation: 下一班去市中心的公交车五分钟后到。

chinese_meanings: adj. 显著的， 突出的； 惹人注目的， 容貌出众的

scenario_translation: 那两姐妹之间有着惊人的相似之处。

scenario_translation: 他的财富并没有给他带来快乐，他怀念拥有真正的朋友。

scenario_translation: 樱桃树开满了花，让街道看起来粉红美丽。

scenario_translation: 我每天早上都能听到窗外鸟儿唱歌。

scenario_example: I usually go to bed at eleven o'clock on weekdays.
scenario_translation: 我工作日通常十一点睡觉。

scenario_example: Let's grab coffee sometime next week.
scenario_translation: 我们下周找个时间一起喝咖啡吧。

chinese_meanings: v. 设立总部，在…设立总部

scenario_translation: 这家公司的总部设在纽约。

scenario_translation: 我请面包师把面团擀成薄圆形做披萨。

scenario_translation: 无论你做出什么决定，我都会支持你。

scenario_translation: 隔壁的小女孩喜欢雨后在水坑里跳。

scenario_translation: 我不得不加快步伐去赶末班火车。

scenario_translation: 每天吃新鲜水果对健康有好处。

scenario_translation: 我用一条沉重的链条锁住了自行车以防被盗。

scenario_translation: 做完饭后别忘了关煤气。

scenario_translation: 统计数据显示，经常锻炼的人比十年前更多了。

scenario_translation: 我们有个约定：谁做晚饭，谁就不用洗碗。

scenario_translation: 我的猫很淘气，喜欢把东西从桌上推下去。

scenario_translation: 我正在学中文，因为我想去北京旅行。

scenario_translation: 婚礼队伍随着音乐缓缓走过通道。

scenario_translation: 教室很明亮，有大窗户和白墙。

scenario_translation: 如果你想存钱买房，应该控制开支。

scenario_translation: 我喜欢周末有朋友的陪伴。

scenario_translation: 我用支票付了房租，因为我没有现金。

scenario_translation: 那只小猫很小，能放在我的手掌心里。

scenario_translation: 我的学生们非常配合，总是认真听讲并互相帮助。
